errors.title: Malformed request
errors.description: Body is not parseable JSON, or empty where a body is required.

errors.title: Not found
errors.description: Unknown path, unknown note id, or malformed id.

errors.title: Method not allowed
errors.description: Known path, method not declared for it.

errors.title: Request with this idempotency key is in progress
errors.description: Same Idempotency-Key while the first request is executing.

errors.title: Note is not editable
errors.description: updateNote on a note that is not a draft.

errors.title: Precondition failed
errors.description: If-Match is not exactly the current strong tag.

errors.title: Unsupported media type
errors.description: Operation with a request body called without Content-Type application/json.

errors.title: Validation failed
errors.description: Query, header or body violates the contract; every violation is listed in errors[].

errors.title: Idempotency key reused with a different request
errors.description: Same Idempotency-Key, different method, path or body.

errors.title: Precondition required
errors.description: If-Match missing on PATCH or DELETE.
